notes.title: Patch to "Overlay words" wordsearch update.
notes.content:
Found a bug in one of the loading mechanisms for continuing saved games.
The bug was introduced in the "Overlay words" update on the 28th February where I changed the format of save game files, but hadn't correctly coded how one of the types of word list was reloaded when it was from an old style save file.

notes.title: Titles removed.
notes.content:
Apparently it would seem that running the animated attacking title while doing the initialising in the background may help towards giving an amateur feel to the game. Running it like that did give some stuttering to the animation under certain circumstances, running it in serial would have alleviated it to some extent.
It was there for 2 reasons:
- to mask the background setup
- to emphasise the idea of the game bombarding you with words, e.g. that you were being "attacked" by them.
On the second point, nobody seems to have associated the "attack" part of the name in the way I'd meant for it to be taken.
Therefore, as it has not appeared to address either of the reasons that it existed, I have decided to remove the titles from the game. On starting the game it will now go straight to the help (if still enabled in the settings) or the main menu.

notes.title: Wordsearch enhancement.
notes.content:
[b]Wordsearch - New "Overlay words" option[/b]
[list]
[*]With this option selected the game plays as before. When placing words to find, they could be placed over one another, e.g. if it were placing the words ONE and TWO, the same "O" could be used for each words placement. You could also use the same letters to find different words, e.g. if you wanted to find ONE and SOMEONE you could find SOMEONE, then use the ONE from that word to find ONE.
[*]With this option unselected, two things happen. Firstly words are placed apart from one another. When placing words all the letters are added as their own unique cell/tile. Secondly, when selecting where words are, if you select a letter that has been used to find another word then that word will be removed from your list of found words and you will need to find it again elsewhere (or in the same place in which case the same thing will happen to the word you just found). As the game progresses you can see less areas where you haven't found words, and therefore less space where you need to look for words. Unless you go wrong and use a word like ONE from a word like SOMEONE, this makes the board easier to complete.
[/list]

[b]Other changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added "Extra saves" option to the setup screen. Previously this was a hidden option that could be added to the setup file manually and related to the wordsearch game. When enabled, every time you find a word the save/continue file is updated, therefore saving you from (most) power losses and other types of crashes. When not enabled the save is only done when you select to exit the board you are playing on.
[*]Word Hunt game changed so that "Extra saves" has a similar effect to that in Wordsearch game. However saving will occur more often, i.e. after each cell is revealed, so theoretically it will have a more noticeable impact on performance.
[/list](Under normal circumstances there is no need to enable "Extra saves".)

notes.title: Mouse button update.

notes.title: Wordsearch Attack Update
notes.content:
Word Attack is a suite of games, as such it is harder to describe and promote than would otherwise be the case. Therefore I decided to take a more focussed concept and spin it off in a stand alone format - hence Wordsearch Attack.
This update includes a number of changes, some of which are to keep it in line with Wordsearch Attack.

To simplify the starting of wordsearch games, I've simplified the board list by introducing Cuboid, Cylinder, Grid and Hex shape classes, rather than specifically sized shapes such as the 7x7x7 cube, 40x19 cylinder etc. When you select a shape class you now need to specify the dimensions to use - Note that this will allow the creation of very large boards, your hardware may not be up to running such large shapes!! Additionally, instead of selecting a dictionary, personality, familiarity etc, you now select a word list. Word lists can be dictionaries or actual lists of words, but in Word Attack can also be personalities (Wordsearch Attack does not have personalities). Also added optional cell edging to boards.

The Word Hunt game gets similar updates to the board creation - Note that the larger boards will need more hardware to run them.

BattleBoards do not get the new board selection. This is because they have boards from the board designer. Instead the board designer gets these changes, so you can select a shape and it's sizes and create a BattleBoard for those dimensions. Once created you can then use it in the BattleBoard game.

Other changes in this update.
- Changes to running in a window:
  - Rotation changes so that effect of dragging board is related to board offset and not centre of screen/window.
  - Changing panel sizes down when window size changed.
  - Change to scrolling windows while resizing them.
- Cell edging changes.
- Highlight changes.
- Colour fixes.
- Revisions to word list loading and filtering.
- Music changes.

I still think that under that branch of the menus the navigation works better that way, so that navigation stays the same.
- Fixed a timer issue where by if the timer had not run out at the end of certain games, it would continue to run down to 0, and if you were waiting to start a new game round then that round would end before it had started (if you started a new round before the timer had reached 0 then the timer would already have reset and the game would run as expected).

notes.title: Another technical update
notes.content:
Following on from the previous technical update, this further expands on how boards can be formed.
Boards are formed from a web of interconnecting cells, this updates changes the way those connections can be made. As long as cells have a balanced number of connections, virtually any shape is theoretically possible. It also fixes an issue in the previous update which resulted in incorrect paths being formed at the corners of cube shaped boards.

notes.content:
Added some more seasonal slanting to the words the computer personalities play. Halloween will no longer be on their minds, with thoughts now turning more and more towards Christmas.
These are ongoing changes and include a couple of small updates to the Halloween settings (for next year). The mechanism is also still under review, so may change in later development cycles.

notes.title: Bio update
notes.content: Addition of some biography text for some of the computer personalities.

notes.title: Update iteration
notes.content: Another agile update iteration, plus a draft of a christmas tree board.

notes.title: Word update
notes.content: Ongoing changes to the words and tuning of personalities.

notes.title: Update of anagrams mini game
notes.content:
An update to the anagrams mini game.
- now shows word definition for anagram
- option to allow alternate words to be ok answers
- can exclude variant words such as those from localised dialects

notes.title: Quick patch
notes.content: Fix to issue with take turns type games sometimes hanging. A change for the parallel play modes was done in some shared code and therefore accidentally was being run out of context.

notes.title: Friendly update
notes.content: Just swapped the default for the manual connect/create screen from public to being friends.
